# Third-party crates allowed in the root Cargo.lock (checked in CI).
#
# The workspace has no third-party dependencies: forgo libraries use only
# std, and forgo_dev only forgo libraries. The one exception is
# wasm-bindgen, for crates made with `cargo x new wasm`; these are the
# crates it pulls in. Adding a name here is a deliberate decision.
#
# Benchmark crates (crates/*_bench) have their own workspaces and
# lockfiles, so their comparison crates don't appear here.

bumpalo
cfg-if
once_cell
proc-macro2
quote
rustversion
syn
unicode-ident
wasm-bindgen
wasm-bindgen-macro
wasm-bindgen-macro-support
wasm-bindgen-shared
